title: Next Up Columbia - July Connect Event at Gators Dockside
description: Next Up Columbia hosts a Develop Event featuring Joy Lutz focused on time management — one of the most valuable skills for young professionals. Attendees gain practical strategies for prioritizing responsibilities and increasing productivity.

title: Lendmark Financial Services: Grand Opening & Ribbon Cutting
location: Lendmark Financial Services, Lake City, FL
description: Grand opening and ribbon cutting ceremony for Lendmark Financial Services' new Lake City location. Chamber members and community welcome to celebrate this new local business.

title: ReadingPals Annual Learning & Impact Virtual Gathering
description: Annual virtual gathering for ReadingPals volunteers and supporters. Learn about program impact, connect with fellow volunteers, and discover how to inspire a kindergartner's love of reading.

title: Chamber 101
location: Lake City-Columbia County Chamber of Commerce, Lake City, FL
description: Crash course on the Chamber organization, services provided, and how to get involved. Ideal for new members, small business owners, and professionals looking to expand their local network.

location: Chicken Salad Chick, Lake City, FL
description: Bi-weekly networking lunch for healthcare professionals to connect, share referrals, and strengthen community impact. Meets 2nd and 4th Tuesday monthly.

description: Hands-on poultry camp for youth exploring chicken care, egg grading, and farm-to-table experiences. Educational, family-friendly program through UF/IFAS Extension.

location: Columbia County Extension Office, Lake City, FL
description: Beginner-friendly camp where young youth explore chickens through hands-on activities, games, and crafts. Fun, educational introduction to poultry for families.

description: Community pickle contest hosted by local brewery Halpatter Brewing. Show off your best pickles, enjoy craft beer, and connect with fellow fermentation enthusiasts. Family-friendly.

location: Lake City Police Department / Host Location, Lake City, FL
description: Community breakfast hosted by Lake City Police Department. Opportunity to meet Chief of Police, discuss community safety, and network with local business leaders and residents.
